style: Cinematic 3D render for a premium investigative documentary, stylized realism with clean matte materials, low-key lighting with deep cold steel-blue and graphite shadows, one pale cool white key light, a faint emerald green glow as the only colour accent, soft volumetric haze, shallow depth of field, 35mm lens, clearly separated foreground, midground and background layers, calm restrained mood, fine film grain.

images.prompt: A gloved hand seen from behind the shoulder sliding a thin brushed steel plate into an open safe-deposit box drawer, inside a quiet bank vault, one narrow beam of light across the drawer.
A single closed brushed steel box resting on a dark vault shelf, a thin paper seal strip across its lid still intact, a fine layer of dust on top catching a narrow beam of light.
A small private viewing room inside a bank, bare dark table with one closed metal box on it under a low hanging lamp, an empty chair pushed in, cold walls fading into darkness.
A small plain matte grey handheld electronic device resting on a dark plinth under a clear glass dome, museum style, cold spotlight from above, reflections on the glass.
A dark cloth pouch tipped over on a wooden table, dozens of small plain blank wooden tiles spilling out across the surface, a few tumbling in midair, soft side light.
Extreme macro view of a dark green circuit board, one tiny chip in focus with a faint emerald glow around it, thin copper traces leading away into soft blur, dust particles in the air.
A thin unplugged cable lying coiled on a dark desk beside an empty socket, light dust on the cable, a pale cool light grazing the surface, everything still.
An empty desk at night in a dark room, a monitor glowing faint green, a desk chair turned away and pushed back as if someone has just left, a cold mug beside the keyboard.
Two analysts seen only from behind as dark silhouettes in a dim room, facing a wall of large screens showing abstract glowing lines flowing from left to right, cold blue light.
A long aisle between tall server racks in a dark data hall, rows of tiny green status lights receding into haze, cold air, polished floor reflecting the lights.
A dark bedroom at night, a smartphone lying face up on a wooden nightstand, its screen quietly lighting up with a soft glow, a bed in soft blur behind, no one visible.
The dark facade of an apartment building at night seen from across the street, two separate windows far apart each lit only by the faint glow of a phone, silhouettes seen from behind.
A neat row of identical dark red wax seal imprints on a long strip of dark paper, all exactly alike, lit by a low raking light, shallow depth of field fading the row into darkness.
A long dark archive corridor lined with tall metal filing cabinets, a single drawer far down the corridor pulled slightly open with pale light spilling out of it.
